Duration 1 round

Effect automatically succeed against any forced-movement or knockdown effect

cinderfall.incomplete: Automatically succeed against forced-movement/knockdown effects for 1 round. The effect-shape alone would match real Immovable Object precedent (pf2e-source/packs/pf2e/feats/archetype/eternal-legend/immovable-object.json, rules: []), but this card is an explicit Redline expenditure -- Deadhand's Tally/Redline mechanic is entirely homebrew with zero schema footprint, which blocks the trigger mechanism regardless of whether the effect itself could be built.
